newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish zloty falls to all-time lows vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Polish zloty falls to all-time lows vs basket.

text.p: 1200 GMT - The zloty closed at all-time lows against the basket at 0.64/0.73 percent below the parity rate against 0.28/0.15 percent above it on Friday on small-scale foreign T-bill sales which strongly moved the very shallow market.
* It closed at 3.3790/30 to the dollar, down from 3.3215/55 on Friday and at 1.8860/70 to the mark, against 1.8875/00.
* O/N and T/N rates close flat at 22.95/23.25 percent despite no drainage and a net inflow of 1.3 billion zlotys.
* Demand at weekly primary T-bill tender 1.07 billion zlotys against one billion offer.
